_description: Privacy Policy for the Spinify mobile application by Sogepps.
intro:
We at Spinify ("App") value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected when you use the app, how it is used, and how it is protected.

By using the App, you accept this Privacy Policy.
s1_p1: Spinify does not require an account or mandatory personal data. The app works as a local wheel and decision tool without asking for your name, email, or phone number.
s1_p2: Data you create in the app may include:
s1_li1: Custom wheel names, categories, and descriptions
s1_li2: Slice labels, emoji, colors, and probability weights
s1_li3: Spin settings (duration, turns, effects, elimination mode)
s1_p3: This information is stored only on your device (local storage) to save your wheels and preferences. It is not uploaded to our servers.
s2_p1: To improve performance and stability, the following anonymous information may be collected automatically:
s2_li2: Device type and operating system version
s2_li3: General diagnostic data from the app platform
s2_p2: This data does not include the content of your wheels and is used only to maintain and improve the App.
s3_p1: Spinify may use third-party advertising services (such as Google AdMob) to show interstitial ads. These providers may collect advertising identifiers and anonymous usage data to deliver and measure ads.
s3_p2: Ad providers are governed by their own privacy policies. You can limit personalized ads in your device settings (Google Ads settings on Android, or App Tracking / privacy settings on iOS).
s4_p1: Spinify does not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal information, please contact us.
s5_p1: We design Spinify to keep your wheel data on your device. We take reasonable measures to protect any data processed by the App.
s5_p2: No method of electronic storage or transmission is 100% secure. Uninstalling the app removes locally stored wheel data from your device.
s6_p1: The App may rely on third-party services (e.g. Google Mobile Ads) with their own privacy practices. Spinify is not responsible for how those services handle data. We recommend reviewing their policies.
s7_p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page and take effect when published.
s8_p1: For questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us:
